_about: Default key bindings (D6; jump and dodge added at Sam's request, 2026-10-03), as KeyboardEvent.code values. The action names are sim::Input::ACTIONS; the page reads the bits from there. A player's own bindings, once Settings has them, live in the save file. One player: the left hand moves (A and D step, W jumps, S stands up, Left Shift dodges) and the right hand drives the arm (I and K the shoulder, J and L the elbow), at Sam's request (2026-10-03). _solo_earlier lists the earlier one-player layouts, oldest first: a save still holding one of them exactly, on the keys that layout names, is moved to the current one, and a player's own choices stay. The throw (2026-10-05) was O for one player, beside the arm keys; it is Space at Sam's request (2026-10-10), so the right hand stays on the arm keys. It is T for the left player and M for the right.
